title: Impact of Thailand’s Proposed Land Bridge Project on Singapore’s Competitiveness as Global Seaport
what_it_is: Impact of Thailand’s Proposed Land Bridge Project on Singapore’s Competitiveness as Global Seaport

sections.label: Thailand land bridge and Tuas Port
sections.summary: A Thailand land bridge could shorten some vessels' travel time versus the Straits of Malacca and Singapore, while Singapore focuses on its port and Tuas Port.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: A land bridge in Thailand could shorten the travelling time for some vessels by a few days, compared with sailing through the Straits of Malacca and Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: The exact time saving will depend on many factors, such as the time needed to unload the cargo from the vessel, then transport it across the land bridge and load onto the vessel at the other end.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: These would likely incur additional expenses for shipping companies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Singapore will continue to focus on enhancing our port's connectivity, productivity and competitiveness.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: The development of Tuas Port will also allow us to accommodate mega container ships, providing shipping companies with the necessary capacity and connectivity to meet their future needs.

sections.label: Singapore port competitiveness and connectivity
sections.summary: The Minister says Singapore cannot prevent others enhancing port facilities, so the key is staying competitive and coordinating with shipping lines.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: I think the Minister mentioned just now, but what would be the worst-case scenario?

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: We cannot prevent others from enhancing their port facilities, their infrastructure, whether it is the land bridge that I addressed in my reply to the questions or some other type of infrastructure enhancements as well as building new capabilities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: So, therefore, the key for us is really to focus on how we, the Port of Singapore, can stay competitive and relevant.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Second, is to look at how we can coordinate better with our shipping lines so that they arrive without waiting too long in our ports, and that when they arrive in our ports, they are able to get good services from a whole suite of services that they will require – bunkering, supplies – not just to load and offload cargo.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: So, the connectivity of our port is the most crucial.
